Package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api

package io.github.brantunger.unruly.api
Public API for the Unruly rules engine.

This package contains the data model used to define and supply facts and rules to the engine:

  • RulesEngine — The main rules engine interface
  • RulesEngineBuilder — Builder to instantiate engines without exposing internal implementations
  • RuleListener — Interface to monitor rule evaluation and action execution
  • LoggingRuleListener — Out-of-the-box SLF4J listener for execution auditing
  • Rule — A rule with a condition, action, and priority
  • FactReference — Interface for a named, typed fact
  • Fact — Default implementation of FactReference
  • FactStore — A Map-based store of facts
  • FactMap — Default implementation of FactStore
